models.inverse_notes: A1 = 1-(1-A)/(1-A2) needs A2 != 1; symmetric for A2. Check: A=0.9999,A2=0.99 gives A1=0.99. A=1 with A2<1 forces A1=1; A1=A2=1 leaves A=1 (both perfect). Algebraic only.
limitations: Needs asserted independence; common-cause or shared-repair dependence needs dynamic RBD/Markov.
Two-component closed form only; N-component 1-(1-X)^N and k-out-of-N need separate records.

models.inverse_notes: T_old = S*T_new needs S,T_new; T_new = T_old/S needs S != 0. Check: S=1.2,T_new=100 gives T_old=120. T_new=0 excluded; S=0 with T_old>0 impossible.
limitations: A bare ratio does not identify the improvable fraction; Amdahl analysis needs f and s separately.
